text:
mike: CI image publish started failing on master after my small Dockerfile tweak. Push job gets stuck during finalize with a lease/timeout error. Can someone triage?

deploy-bot: job #1245 image-publish (push) failed: "finalize upload: lease expired" :x: https://ci.internal/runs/1245

sara: can you paste the last ~20 lines of the push log?

mike: paste below:
```
# push output
Pushing manifest for image: registry.internal/redwood/service:main
Uploading layer 1/5: 4.2MB
Uploading layer 2/5: 12.8MB
Uploading layer 3/5: chunked upload started
Uploading layer 3/5: chunked upload finished
Finalizing upload... error: finalize upload: lease expired (object not found)
````

jen: hmm. lease expired usually means the registry held a temporary upload key that got revoked/GC'd before finalize. Did you change something that lengthened the build/push?

mike: I added a small chown and a few RUN steps, but total build time only +20s. CI logs show the push waited ~3m between chunked upload and finalize.

harry: FYI we rotated reg credentials yesterday at 11:00 UTC and shortened temporary token TTL to 5m for safety. CI should pick up renewed tokens on job start, but long-lived upload sessions can still fail.

mike: oh nice catch. So rerun should help?

jen: usually yes — rerun will fetch fresh creds and push succeeds. If it still fails, it might be a cache / blob mismatch on the registry side (artifact was uploaded but not linked). Two quick options: 1) rerun; 2) change the tag (append -ci<shortsha>) and push to new tag so we avoid manifest collision.

mike: rerun result: another failure, different error now:
```
error: failed to push some refs to registry.internal
failed to upload layer: received unexpected status: 404 Not Found 
cause: blob unknown to registry
```

sara: blob unknown usually means the registry GC removed the temp blobs, or the upload session got corrupted. Could be a cache problem where one node thinks the blob exists.

harry: I'm pulling infra logs now. @infra-team can you check registry node health / object store latency around 1769054300-1769054360?

infra-team: looking. We see a short spike in object-store latency and a few repeated `PutObject` timeouts around that window. No global outage, but a couple of worker retries. We also see stale multipart uploads older than 1h; we'll sweep them.

jen: pragmatic fix: change the tag and rerun the pipeline (cheap). If that works we can reattempt to push main later after registry sweep. For long term: increase upload session TTL for CI or switch to pushing smaller chunks and streaming layers earlier (buildx options).

mike: ok I'm going to bump the tag to `main-ci-1769054322` and rerun. pinging back here in a minute. :pray:

(mike edited): rerun with new tag started and push completed successfully. 

mike: thanks everyone. Action items: harry/infra to sweep orphaned multipart uploads and check TTL settings; eng-infra to consider CI runner change to refresh registry creds mid-push or reduce chunk size. I'll open a quick PR to tag CI artifacts uniquely to avoid blocker reruns.

sara: sounds good — please include the log excerpts and the two errors in the PR so we can track recurrence.

harry: infra will run the sweep and follow up in this thread with results. :white_check_mark:

infra-team: sweep finished, removed 12 orphan uploads, increased temporary upload window for internal CI by +2m as a safety buffer. We'll monitor for regressions.

mike: closing the loop — push succeeded with unique tag, and infra changes look good. Thanks all :tada:
